title: The Surangama Sutra (Class Part 4)
speaker: Kanho Chris Burkhart and IkuShun Desiree Webster
summary: Kanho Chris Burkhart and IkuShun Desiree Webster take up the closing chapters of the Surangama Sutra in this fourth class. IkuShun reads Avalokiteshvara's account of turning hearing inward, with its 32 forms and thousand arms, and connects those forms to skillful means and to meeting each patient where they are as a dietitian. IkuShun then reads Manjushri's verse and Xuan Hua's commentary, and sends the class to breakout rooms to compare reversing hearing with Dogen's backwards step. Kanho plays a recording of the Surangama mantra, then reads the Buddha's teaching that sexual desire binds beings to birth and death. Kanho closes by asking how sexual desire differs from hunger and tiredness.
topics: Buddhist teachings on sex and meditation

So it was that *as I gradually progressed, what I heard and my awareness of what I heard came to an end.
